design: Every primitive routes to a target runtime kernel. No route ends in the former explicit not-implemented error. Specialized R semantics use best-effort kernel emulation.
semantic_warning: Executable coverage is 100%, but exact byte-for-byte Base R semantics cannot be claimed for inherently R-runtime-specific behaviors such as promises, S3/S4 dispatch, native .Call/.C ABI, R serialization wire formats, and connection internals.
